title: Show HN: Hsrs – Type-Safe Haskell Bindings Generator for Rust
summary: Hsrs is a type-safe Haskell bindings generator for Rust that creates rich bindings between the two languages, filling a gap in the tooling ecosystem where no similar code generator existed before. It follows the same developer-friendly patterns as popular tools like pyo3 and napi-rs.
problem_solved: Solves the lack of type-safe, rich bindings generators for creating Haskell bindings from Rust code.
why_valuable: Enables Rust developers to leverage Haskell's rich type system and features through type-safe FFI bindings, following proven patterns from established binding generators.
